reference.title: High-pressure equation of state for NaCl, KCl, and CsCl

methods.source_location: Redfern et al. (1993), Experimental Methods, page 2099
methods.notes: The primary paper states that pressure was calculated from the least-squares-refined cell volume of internal NaCl using the Decker (1971) EOS; the estimated pressure uncertainty is +/-2%.

recalculation.notes: Table 1 provides calibrated sample pressures but not the corresponding row-wise NaCl cell volumes.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

scientific_validation.note: Original four-page paper, Experimental Methods, Table 1, equations (1)-(2), and Figure 2 caption checked. All 18 table rows are bundled and the reduced Birch fit is directly reproduced.

primary_source_check.finding: The source publishes 18 pressure-volume rows and reports an all-row reduced Birch least-squares fit with V0=279.4(2) A3, K0=142(9) GPa, and K0'=4.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from the Equation-of-State section (p. 2100): a least-squares reduced Birch fit to all 18 Table 1 rows, normalized to the Table 1 ambient V0.

primary_data_check.finding: All 18 printed pressure, lattice-parameter, cell-volume, and parenthetical-uncertainty rows are transcribed directly from Table 1; no figure digitization is used.

securely_resolved.V0: fixed to the measured ambient Table 1 value

fit_protocol.objective: The paper states least squares but does not specify residual direction or weighting; the reproduction uses unweighted pressure residuals.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Abstract; Experimental Methods, page 2099; Table 1 and Equation-of-State section, page 2100.
parameter_provenance.equation: Equation-of-State section, page 2100: least-squares fit to the reduced Birch equation with K0'=4.
parameter_provenance.parameters: Abstract and page 2100: Table 1 ambient V0=279.4(2) A3; the reduced fit gives K0=142(9) GPa with K0'=4. V0 is the measured reference volume used to form V/V0 and is fixed in the reproduction.

reference.title: High-pressure equation of state for NaCl, KCl, and CsCl

methods.source_location: Redfern et al. (1993), Experimental Methods, page 2099
methods.notes: The primary paper states that pressure was calculated from the least-squares-refined cell volume of internal NaCl using the Decker (1971) EOS; the estimated pressure uncertainty is +/-2%.

recalculation.notes: Table 1 provides calibrated sample pressures but not the corresponding row-wise NaCl cell volumes.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

scientific_validation.note: Original four-page paper, Experimental Methods, Table 1, equations (1)-(2), and Figure 2 caption checked. All 18 table rows are bundled and the nine-row finite-strain selection is directly refitted.

locations: Table 1, Equation (2), and Figure 2 caption, page 2100
primary_source_check.finding: The source publishes 18 pressure-volume rows and reports a weighted finite-strain regression of the nine rows with fV>0.01, giving K0=151(7) GPa and fitted K0'=2.5.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Equation (2) and the Figure 2 caption (p. 2100): a weighted finite-strain regression of the nine Table 1 rows with fV > 0.01. Yu et al. (2024) list K0' as fixed, but the source fitted it.

primary_data_check.finding: All 18 printed pressure, lattice-parameter, cell-volume, and parenthetical-uncertainty rows are transcribed directly from Table 1; no figure digitization is used.

securely_resolved.V0: fixed to the measured ambient Table 1 value used to define fV

fit_protocol.selection: Nine Table 1 rows with Eulerian strain fV>0.01 (4.6-19.7 GPa).
fit_protocol.objective: The paper states weighted regression of the volume data but does not publish the exact weighting implementation; the reproduction minimizes volume residuals using the printed one-sigma volume uncertainties.

independent_refit.qualification: The fitted coefficients are consistent with the published fit, but K0_prime is weakly constrained (refit one-sigma uncertainty 1.345) and the source reports no K0_prime uncertainty, so strict uncertainty parity cannot be established.

reported_inconsistencies.finding: The comparison table marks the Redfern K0'=2.5 value as fixed.
reported_inconsistencies.resolution: Rejected for source mapping because the Redfern publisher abstract calls it the full fit and Ross (1997) explicitly states that K0' was not constrained.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Abstract; Experimental Methods, page 2099; Table 1, Equation (2), and Figure 2 caption, page 2100.
parameter_provenance.equation: Equation (2) and Figure 2, page 2100: third-order Eulerian finite-strain Birch-Murnaghan analysis for observations with fV>0.01.
parameter_provenance.parameters: Abstract, Equation-of-State section, and Figure 2 caption: Table 1 ambient V0=279.4(2) A3; weighted regression gives K0=151(7) GPa and fitted K0'=2.5. V0 defines the reported finite strains and is fixed in the reproduction.
